create_policy_gradient_agent: create a PolicyGradient agent with A2C loss for single-agent reinforcement learning in OpenSpiel
build_mlp_torso_network: build an MLPTorso neural network module with configurable hidden layer sizes and ReLU activations
run_policy_gradient_training: run policy gradient training with critic and policy network updates on sampled episode transitions
test_loss_computation: test QPG, RPG, RMPG, A2C, and NeuRD loss computations on batched transition data
save_restore_checkpoint: save and restore PolicyGradient agent model weights from checkpoint directories
